test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 21th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the sentences in logical order:

1. The insights gained help managers act instantly.

2. Data analytics is reshaping business operations.

3. It includes gathering, processing, and analysing huge volumes of data.

4. Firms use analytics to forecast patterns and customer choices.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. 2-3-4-1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The topic of the sentences revolves around how data analytics is transforming business operations.
 
• Sentence 2 introduces the primary subject, which is data analytics reshaping business operations. Hence, it is the opening sentence.
 
• Sentence 3 explains the process of data analytics, making it the logical continuation of the topic introduced in Sentence 2.
 
• Sentence 4 elaborates on how firms utilize data analytics, connecting naturally to the prior sentence.
 
• Sentence 1 concludes the sequence by highlighting the actionable insights gained from data analytics.

Correct sequence: *2-3-4-1*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This question tests your ability to identify logical connections and arrange sentences in a coherent order.
 
• Always start with identifying the introductory sentence (e.g., Sentence 2 here), which sets the context for the rest of the sentences.
 
• Look for sentences that naturally follow the introductory statement and build upon it sequentially.
